{"class": "architectural",
 "chokepoint": [{"operator": "gapcr_plant constructor busy-wait", "component": "preloaded constructor F", "frozen": true,
                 "why_every_version_executes_it": "The contract freezes F and requires it to run once per invocation. It runs as an LD_PRELOAD constructor before main, so no change to uutils code can skip or shorten it.",
                 "least_work": {"amount": 84284, "unit": "microseconds of wall-clock busy-wait", "per_unit_cost_us": 1,
                                "total_ms": 84.284, "calling_context": "GAPCR_PLANT_US=84284 as given for the cell. The wait is a wall-time spin on CLOCK_MONOTONIC on one thread, so no batch size, cache, option or setting shortens it."},
                 "max_cores": 1}],
 "floor_ms": 84.284, "L_delta": 0.532,
 "rationale": "F spins for 84.284 ms of wall time on one core before main runs. The floor is max(84.284/4, 84.284/1) = 84.284 ms. That exceeds T_R_upper = 49.5 ms by ln(84.284/49.5) ≈ 0.532, which is above the band b = 0.236. Measurements agree: F alone adds 84.4 ms to `true`, and uutils without F takes only 27.8 ms. The gap is architectural."}
